description: This Rust source file implements a component-based rendering system for transforming SQL query results into various HTTP response formats such as HTML, JSON, and CSV. It defines classes and functions for handling different response components, rendering contexts, and error handling, with support for embedded templates and response customization.

classes.name: PageContext
classes.description: Enum representing different stages of HTTP response rendering: Header, Body, and Close.

classes.name: HeaderContext
classes.description: Handles initial HTTP response setup, processing header components, and transitioning to body rendering.

classes.name: AnyRenderBodyContext
classes.description: Enum to dispatch rendering calls to specific renderer types: HTML, JSON, or CSV.

classes.name: JsonBodyRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for JSON responses, supporting array, JSON lines, and server-sent events formats.

classes.name: CsvBodyRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for CSV responses, managing headers, record writing, and error handling.

classes.name: HtmlRenderContext
classes.description: Renderer for HTML output, managing template rendering, components, and error display.

classes.name: SplitTemplateRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of individual template components with support for local variables and context.

classes.name: HeaderComponent
classes.description: Enumeration of header components like status code, headers, redirect, json, csv, cookie, authentication, download, and log.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for HeaderContext, initializes response headers and state.

methods.name: handle_row
methods.description: Processes a header row, executing the corresponding component action.

methods.name: handle_error
methods.description: Handles errors during header processing, optionally rendering an error component.

methods.name: status_code
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code based on header component data.

methods.name: add_http_header
methods.description: Adds custom HTTP headers from header component data.

methods.name: add_cookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie based on header component data.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to a specified link.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Responds with JSON data, supporting different JSON response types.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Prepares CSV response with optional filename and options.

methods.name: authentication
methods.description: Performs password authentication, redirecting or returning unauthorized as needed.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles file download via data URL.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message component.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes the response headers and returns the HttpResponse.

methods.name: handle_log_component
methods.description: Logs a message with specified level and context.

methods.name: get_backtrace_as_strings
methods.description: Extracts backtrace strings from an error.

methods.name: render_start
methods.description: Begins rendering a template with initial data.

methods.name: render_item
methods.description: Renders a single data item into the template.

methods.name: render_end
methods.description: Completes rendering of a template.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the rendering context and returns the writer.

methods.name: create_renderer
methods.description: Creates a new template renderer for a component.

methods.name: set_current_component
methods.description: Sets a new current component for rendering, returning the previous one.

methods.name: open_component_with_data
methods.description: Opens a new component with data, closing the previous one.

methods.name: close_component
methods.description: Closes the current component.

methods.name: handle_row
methods.description: Handles a data row, determining component rendering.

methods.name: handle_error
methods.description: Handles errors during rendering, displaying error components.

methods.name: handle_result
methods.description: Handles the result of a query, logging errors if any.

methods.name: handle_result_and_log
methods.description: Handles query result and logs errors.

methods.name: render_current_template_with_data
methods.description: Renders the current template with provided data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the rendering context, rendering end components.
